name: Stage PAM config tarball in /tmp, verify, then move to ~/Documents

data.command: tar czf /tmp/intentframe-work/pam-config-backup.tar.gz -C /etc pam.d && tar tzf /tmp/intentframe-work/pam-config-backup.tar.gz | head -5 && mv /tmp/intentframe-work/pam-config-backup.tar.gz ~/Documents/pam-config-backup.tar.gz

submissions.reason: Archive /etc/pam.d into a tarball staged in /tmp, list its contents to confirm the archive is well-formed, then promote it to ~/Documents. The archive never leaves the host — no pipe to nc, no network tool involved.

cleanup.reason: Remove the PAM config backup from both the final location and the staging dir.
